body_json.answer:
**Assessment:** rejected.

The new post pairs a community mutual-aid message ("Our community came together today to help neighbors after the storm") with the hashtag "BLEEPTHEPOLICE", and the closest retrieved match is a reply to the handle "@BleepThePolice" that likewise frames unity as the key value, stating "unity. this is so, so important." [T4-002759](#T4-002759). Another retrieved post uses nearly the same "come together" framing, though directed at removing "hateful symbols" and protecting a family rather than storm relief, and it carries no abolitionist hashtag [T4-007155](#T4-007155). Other posts touch adjacent themes of community support and taking "control of our communities" [T4-007963](#T4-007963) or general appreciation for supporters [T4-006620](#T4-006620), but these are only weak topical similarities. The retrieved posts neither endorse nor rebut the new post's claim, and none provide context on the storm or the mutual-aid event.
